app.title: KetchUp – Open-source SketchUp alternative built with Rust and WebGPU
app.description: A browser-based 3D modeling application similar to SketchUp, written in Rust with WebGPU bindings.
proposed_tests: Start dev server with `cargo run` and open localhost in browser
Measure load time and frame rate when opening a complex scene
Run unit tests with `cargo test` and confirm 100% coverage
Build production bundle and verify bundle size < 5MB
